t: If α and β are the roots of equation x<sup>2</sup> - √17x + 4 = 0, then which of the following equation has roots (α<sup> </sup> - β)<sup>2</sup> and '4αβ'?
e:
Given equation: x<sup>2</sup> - √17x + 4 = 0
Sum of roots = α + β = -b/a = √17
Product of roots = αβ = c/a = 4
(α - β)<sup>2</sup> = (α + β)<sup>2</sup> - 4αβ
(α - β)<sup>2</sup> = (√17)<sup>2</sup> - 4 * 4
(α - β)<sup>2</sup> = 17 - 16 = 1
α - β = 1
Equation that has the roots (α<sup> </sup> - β)<sup>2</sup> and '4αβ'= x<sup>2</sup> - Sum of roots * x + Product of roots = 0
Sum of roots = (α<sup> </sup> - β)<sup>2</sup> + 4αβ = 1<sup>2</sup> + 4*4 = 17
Product of roots = (α - β)<sup>2</sup> * 4αβ = 1 * 4 * 4 = 16
Required equation = x<sup>2</sup> - 17x + 16 = 0
h: यदि x<sup>2</sup> - √17x + 4 = 0 समीकरण के मूल α और β हैं, तो निम्नलिखित समीकरणों में से किसके मूल (α<sup> </sup>- β)<sup>2</sup> और '4αβ' है?

t: If 27(X + Y)<sup>3</sup> - 64(X - Y)<sup>3</sup> = (13Y - X) (AX<sup>2</sup> + BY<sup>2</sup> + CXY), then what is the value of (A + B - C)?
e:
27 (X + Y)<sup>3</sup> - 64 (X - Y)<sup>3</sup> = (13Y - X) (AX<sup>2</sup> + BY<sup>2</sup> + CXY)
27 [X<sup>3</sup> + Y<sup>3</sup> + 3XY (X + Y)] - 64 [X<sup>3</sup> - Y<sup>3</sup> - 3XY (X - Y)] = 13AX<sup>2</sup>Y + 13BY<sup>3</sup> + 13CXY<sup>2</sup> - AX<sup>3</sup> - BY<sup>2</sup>X - CX<sup>2</sup>Y
-37X<sup>3</sup> + 91Y<sup>3</sup> + 273X<sup>2</sup>Y - 111XY<sup>2</sup> = 13AX<sup>2</sup>Y + 13BY<sup>3</sup> + 13CXY<sup>2</sup> - AX<sup>3</sup> - BY<sup>2</sup>X - CX<sup>2</sup>Y
Comparing the value of A, B, and C in LHS and RHS
-AX<sup>3</sup> = -37X<sup>3</sup>
A = 37
13BY<sup>3</sup> = 91Y<sup>3</sup>
B = 7
273X<sup>2</sup>Y = 13AX<sup>2</sup>Y - CX<sup>2</sup>Y
273 = 13A - C
C = 208
A + B - C = 37 + 7 - 208 = -164
h: यदि 27(X + Y)<sup>3</sup> - 64(X - Y)<sup>3</sup> = (13Y - X) (AX<sup>2</sup> + BY<sup>2</sup> + CXY), तो (A + B - C) का मान क्या है?

t: If for two real constants M and B the expression Mx<sup>3</sup> + 3x<sup>2</sup> - 5x + N = 0 is exactly divisible by (x + 1) and (x - 1), then find the value of 3M + N.
e:
Mx<sup>3</sup> + 3x<sup>2</sup> - 5x + N = 0 is exactly divisible by (x + 1) and (x - 1).
(x + 1) and (x - 1) are factors.
Now,
X + 1 = 0 or x = -1
And
X - 1 = 0 or x = 1
When x = -1,
Expression: -M + 3 + 5 + N = 0
M - N = 8 ... (1)
When x = 1,
Expression: M + 3 - 5 + N = 0
M + N = 2 ... (2)
Adding (1) and (2),
2M = 10
M = 5
And therefore, N = 2 - 5 = -3
Now,
3M + N = 3 x 5 - 3 = 12
h: यदि दो वास्तविक स्थिरांक M और B के लिए व्यंजक Mx<sup>3</sup> + 3x<sup>2</sup> - 5x + N = 0, (x + 1) और (x - 1) से पूर्णतः विभाज्य है, तो 3M + N का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: If a and b are roots of quadratic equation x<sup>2</sup> - 22x + 85 = 0 and a > b, then how many numbers between 100 and 1500 are divisible by both (a - b) and average of a and b?
e:
x<sup>2</sup> - 22x + 85 = 0
x<sup>2</sup> - 17x - 5x + 85 = 0
x = 17, 5
a = 17, b = 5
a - b = 17 - 5 = 12
Average of a and b = (17 + 5)/2 = 11
Numbers divisible by both 12 and 11 = numbers divisible by LCM of 12 and 11
LCM of 12 and 11 = 132
Numbers between 100 and 1500 which are divisible by 132 = 132, 264,...., 1452.
Total numbers = ((1452 - 132)/1320 + 1 = 11
h: यदि a और b द्विघात समीकरण x<sup>2</sup> - 22x + 85 = 0 और a > b के मूल हैं, तो 100 और 1500 के बीच कितनी संख्याएँ (a - b) और a और b के औसत दोनों से विभाज्य हैं?

t: What number should be subtracted from x<sup>3</sup> - 4x<sup>2</sup> - 8x + 11 to make the number divisible by (x + 2)?
e:
If an equation is divisible by (x+2), so it means (x+2) is a factor of that equation.
So, x+2=0, x=-2
Now putting the value of x=-2 in the equation x<sup>3</sup> - 4x<sup>2</sup> - 8x + 11, we get:
(-2)<sup>3</sup> - 4(-2)<sup>2</sup> - 8(-2) +11
=-8-16+16+11
=3
So if 3 is subtracted from x<sup>3</sup> - 4x<sup>2</sup> - 8x + 11 , it will be completely divisible by (x+2)
Option (c) is the correct answer.
h: x<sup>3</sup> - 4x<sup>2</sup> - 8x + 11 में से कौन सी संख्या घटाई जानी चाहिए ताकि संख्या (x + 2) से विभाज्य हो जाए?

t: If α + β + γ = 0, then (5β<sup>2</sup> + 2α<sup>2</sup> + γ<sup>2</sup>)/( 6β<sup>2</sup> + 3α<sup>2 </sup>+ 2αβ) = ?
e:
α + β + γ = 0
γ = - (α + β)
substitute γ = -(α + β) into the formula :
{5β<sup>2</sup> + 2α<sup>2</sup> + [-(α + β)<sup>2</sup>]/{ 6β<sup>2</sup> + 3α<sup>2 </sup>+ 2αβ}
=> [5β<sup>2</sup> + 2α<sup>2</sup> + (α + β)<sup>2</sup>] / {6β<sup>2</sup> + 3α<sup>2 </sup>+ 2αβ}
=> (5β<sup>2</sup> + 2α<sup>2</sup> + α<sup>2</sup> + 2αβ + β<sup>2</sup>)/( 6β<sup>2</sup> + 3α<sup>2 </sup>+ 2αβ)
=> (5β<sup>2</sup> + 3α<sup>2</sup> + 2αβ + β<sup>2</sup>)/( 6β<sup>2</sup> + 3α<sup>2 </sup>+ 2αβ)
=> (6β<sup>2</sup> + 3α<sup>2</sup> + 2αβ)/(6β<sup>2</sup> + 3α<sup>2 </sup>+ 2αβ)
=> (6β<sup>2</sup> + 3α<sup>2 </sup>+ 2αβ)/(6β<sup>2</sup> + 3α<sup>2 </sup>+ 2αβ)
=> 1
h: यदि α + β + γ = 0, फिर (5β<sup>2</sup> + 2α<sup>2</sup> + γ<sup>2</sup>)/( 6β<sup>2</sup> + 3α<sup>2 </sup>+ 2αβ) = ?

t: Find the remainder when 7x<sup>5</sup> + 15x<sup>4</sup> - 6x<sup>3</sup> + x + 20 is divided by x + 3.
e:
By remainder theorem:
x + 3 = 0
x = -3
By putting the value of x in 7x<sup>5</sup> + 15x<sup>4</sup> - 6x<sup>3</sup> + x + 20, we can find the remainder.
7x<sup>5</sup> + 15x<sup>4</sup> - 6x<sup>3</sup> + x + 20
= 7 * (-3)<sup>5</sup> + 15 * (-3)<sup>4</sup> - 6 * (-3)<sup>3</sup> + (-3) + 20
= 81(-21 + 15) + 162 - 3 + 20
= - 486 + 179
= - 307
h: 7x<sup>5</sup> + 15x<sup>4</sup> - 6x<sup>3</sup> + x + 20 को x + 3 से विभाजित करने पर शेषफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: α and β are roots of the equation x<sup>2</sup> - 5x + 8 = 0. What is the value of 1/α<sup>4</sup> + 1/β<sup>4</sup>?
e:
x<sup>2</sup> - 5x + 8 = 0
So, α + β = 5 and αβ = 8
1/α<sup>4</sup> + 1/β<sup>4</sup>
= (α<sup>4</sup> + β<sup>4</sup>)/(αβ)<sup>4</sup>
α<sup>4</sup> + β<sup>4</sup>
= (α<sup>2</sup>)<sup>2</sup> + (β<sup>2</sup>)<sup>2</sup>
= (α<sup>2</sup> + β<sup>2</sup>)<sup>2</sup> - 2α<sup>2</sup>β<sup>2</sup>
= ((α + β)<sup>2</sup> - 2αβ)<sup>2</sup>) - 2(αβ)<sup>2</sup>
= (5<sup>2</sup> - 2*8)<sup>2</sup> - 2*8<sup>2</sup>
= 81 - 128
= − 47
So, 1/α<sup>4</sup> + 1/β<sup>4</sup>
= − 47/8<sup>4</sup>
= − 47/4096
h: α और β समीकरण x<sup>2</sup> - 5x + 8 = 0 के मूल हैं। 1/α<sup>4</sup> + 1/β<sup>4</sup> का मान क्या है?
